created_by.description: Only alerts created by the user with this UUID.

label.description: Only alerts with this label, as key:value, such as team:billing. Repeat the parameter for more than one label. An alert matches when it has any of the values given for a key, and a match for every key.

legacy_configuration_id.description: Only the alert copied from, or created with, this source configuration, such as a logs alert's id.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

muted.description: Only alerts that hold their messages for any of these reasons. snoozed: the alert or one of its groups is snoozed now. quiet_hours: the alert has quiet hours. Repeat the parameter for more than one reason.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

source_kind.description: Only alerts of these source kinds, such as metrics. Repeat the parameter for more than one kind. A kind the caller cannot read returns no alerts.

items.description:
* `logs` - Logs
* `insight` - Insight
* `warehouse_source` - Warehouse source
* `warehouse_destination` - Warehouse destination
* `metrics` - Metrics
* `traces` - Traces
* `error_tracking` - Error tracking

state.description: Only alerts in any of these states. An enabled alert is in each state that one of its groups is in. An alert with no group is not_checked, and a disabled alert is only disabled. Repeat the parameter for more than one state.

items.description:
* `broken` - Broken
* `errored` - Errored
* `firing` - Firing
* `snoozed` - Snoozed
* `not_firing` - Not firing
* `disabled` - Disabled
* `not_checked` - Not checked yet
